root_cause_found_independently_by_both.finding: Renaming the variant class from r2 to r3 left every rule scoped to `.screen.r2` inert. The list lost its overflow-y:auto, its min-height:0 and its 8px gap; the pill lost its 32% wash and its 48px gutter; the ask lost its 20px. Only the mask, written fresh under `.screen.r3`, carried. Seven of the round's findings were that reversion rather than new work.
consequences: many/wide: the pill and the commit overlap by 16px and the commit paints on top, so elementFromPoint at the pill's bottom edge returns the commit. A parent reaching for 'Another child' checks in six children irreversibly.

At seven siblings — the supported maximum — the list draws straight through the green button on both orientations. Taps on the commit's top half land on a sibling row, which removes a child. The parent of eight cannot read the button they are about to press.
Five sibling toggles butted flush at zero pitch: a tap 8px off a boundary unticks a child, with opacity-60 on a dark card as the only feedback.

other_majors: The fade was unconditional, so in `family` — the commonest scene — the single sibling dissolved from her own midpoint into the page. A gradient to transparent is the vocabulary of 'this is cut off'; on a complete row it reads as deletion or as a fault. Same wrong-data outcome the fade was added to prevent, running the other way. And `.more`, whose comment is 'what the scroller is hiding, said where it is hidden', was styled but never emitted.

The grid had no column track, so its implicit one sized to max-content — the rendered width of 'Nia Washington' at 48px bold. Every child got a differently sized commit button: 240px for a five-character name, 448px for a long hyphenated one. Two parents in the same queue see the primary action at different widths. The wide viewport's 576px cap could never bind, so the landscape kiosk was byte-for-byte the portrait column with 850px of black either side.

`height: min(100%, 51.25rem); margin: auto` — vertical auto margins on a block-level box in normal flow compute to zero, so the band was pinned to the top of the glass for two rounds. The commit sat at 49.5% of a portrait kiosk, not the 72% its own note claimed.
confirmed_working: The commit is genuinely fixed across all four scenes — the anchor itself works, it was anchored to the wrong place.
The antecedent fix holds: 'Anyone else?' is a question and the pill answers it, so 'Another child' can no longer be read as 'not this child, show me a different one'.
`alone` reads as a composed cluster rather than a cluster in a void.
The parent does know the child they went to find is in — full-luminance name, green tick, and the count moved.
fixed_in_r4: Every rule rescoped by element rather than by variant, so it cannot silently unhook again.
The list is the only shrinkable child; the question and the add-row hold their intrinsic height, so the pill can never ride down under the commit.
The fade is emitted only when the list actually overflows.
An explicit column track — minmax(0, 28rem), 36rem wide — with the screen at width:100% so justify-content:center has something to centre in.
body is a flex container, so the band actually centres: the commit's centre lands near 68% of a portrait glass.
Row pitch back to 8px; chevron down from 28px to 24px; ask back to 20px.
